title: Storyteller flattening vectors
description: A file of kind flattening: how the Content object of a configuration becomes the keys of one target, or the error that makes it invalid for that target.

target.description: flat: the ':' keys of IConfiguration. properties: Spring Boot keys, '.' and [i]. env: environment variable names, upper-case and joined with '__'. The names of the API's ?format=.

document.description: The Content object of a configuration; any JSON value for the not-an-object vectors.

keys.description: Every key with its raw text, compared by exact text; the order is the document order.

error.description: The first error: the base rules over the whole document, then the target's name rule, then its value rule, each in document order. Its rule and the JSON path it names.
